frame.comment: The darkest rung in light, so it is where every darkening overlay and the tertiary step come closest.

background.comment: The sheet, dE 3.67 over the frame.

subtle.comment: The card, dE 1.82 over the sheet: near-flat, because a card is found by its hairline.

elevated.comment: Raised is a step DOWN in light: a chip on a white card reads by being greyer than it, dE 3.65.

hover.comment: The approved hover is an OPAQUE #ebebe8, and it sits dE 0.60 off the frame: on the rail a hovered row was not there at all. Fitted as the dark alpha is, and held by the floor that a hovered row separates from every rung by dE 3 (3.10 on the frame): it lands dE 2.50 from the design on the frame, 1.06 on the sheet, 2.80 on the card and 0.75 on raised.

pressed.comment: The least alpha that separates a pressed row from a hovered one by dE 3 on every rung. The approved design draws no pressed state.

tertiary.comment: The approved #696972, darkened dE 3.88 along lightness: it measured 3.83:1 on a pressed row on the frame, 4.22:1 on a hovered row in the rail, and 2.94:1 as a sort arrow drawn at 0.7.

muted.comment: Decoration only. The approved #a3a3aa measured 2.51:1 on the card and 2.14:1 on the rail, under even the decoration band; darkened dE 7.20, the least that brings both inside it.

accent.comment: The approved violet for light, and the primary action's fill. White clears 5.62:1 on it.

accentHover.comment: A step darker: the least move along lightness a reader can see (dE 3.03), taking white to 6.43:1. The approved brightening hover, #744bff, still cleared the floor here (5.01:1), but it moved toward the label rather than away from it.

accentActive.comment: dE 3.18 past the hover. White clears 7.41:1.

accentInk.comment: The approved step, unmoved: 5.00:1 at its tightest, on a pressed row on the frame.

accentSoft.comment: The approved 0.10, raised to 0.109: at 0.10 a selected row sat only dE 2.64 from a hovered one on the frame (2.70 on the sheet), under the dE 3 that tells the two apart, and 0.109 is the least alpha that clears it on every rung (3.02 on the frame). It cannot rise far: at 0.14 the control boundary on a selected row on the frame falls under 3:1.

strongHover.comment: The default-to-strong step, dE 5.23, taken once more.

control.comment: The approved neutral mark, #8e8e96, darkened dE 6.71: it measured 2.29:1 on a pressed row on the frame. The plain border is never a control's edge: #e4e4e7 on white measured 1.27:1, which is a boundary a reader cannot find.

focus.comment: The accent, unmoved: 3.97:1 at its tightest, on a pressed row on the frame.

success.comment: #46a758 measured 2.37:1 as a mark, under the 3:1 non-text floor.

danger.comment: White on #ef4444 measured 3.76:1, so the label of a destructive button was under the text floor.

info.comment: #3b82f6 measured 2.87:1 as a mark and sat only dE 6.0 from the accent, so an info badge read as a selection.

onboarding.comment: #86198f sat dE 3.1 from the info fill under deuteranopia, so an onboarding tag read as an info badge.

execute.comment: #5b37da darkened dE 8.14 along lightness: once the accent became #6b45f0 it sat dE 5.2 from it under every vision, against the 10 and 8 no hue may come within. The first step dark enough for that, dE 6, took it within 10 of onboarding under protanopia; this is the least move that holds both.

1.comment: It used to be byte-identical to the accent, which silently exempted it from the rule that no hue sits within dE 10 of the accent. It keeps uilet indigo as the first series and stops being the colour that means HERE.

4.comment: A grass green rather than the forest green it was. #166534 sat dE 6.0 from the danger red under deuteranopia and 8.0 under protanopia, so the reader scanning a chart for failure could not tell the fourth series from it. Under normal vision they were 24.0 apart, which is how a rule measured under one vision missed it. This is as far as the reserved red can be pushed while the series is still a green, still clears 3:1 as a mark on white, and still separates from the pink beside it in the ramp.

other.comment: The approved neutral mark, #8e8e96, darkened dE 2.33: it measured 2.77:1 as a mark on the frame.

sheet.comment: The xl step turned onto the inline axis. The alphas are the light palette's own: a 0.4 black cast 8px into a near-white page is a smear rather than an edge.

hairline.comment: On a light ground a panel is lifted by its shadow. The top-edge rim light is a dark-palette device and would be invisible here.
